title: Hatsune Miku — So Hoppy To See You!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Humhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Someone's in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! The show the plushies put on yesterday was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was super good!
Hey, look! There are the plushies right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah! Hi, plushies♪
Your show yesterday was sooo much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really liked the part where everyone did a line dance!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My favorite part was the chorus. Your song was really cute!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The audience was all smiles, too. It was lovely to see.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm so glad we did it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: It's because you all helped us out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. We're glad to have been of assistance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But remember, we're not the ones who made it a big success!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was all of you, and the lots and lots of practice you put in☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it was so much fun! I can't wait to see the next one!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: About that... There's something we want to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ooh, what?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If we can help, we'd be happy to!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Um, so, everyone says the show was lots of fun, and they want us to do another one.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: They keep asking when the next one will be, and they seem really excited.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That shows how much you made everyone's hearts sparkle and jump♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: So, we'd like your help again. Because we can't think of any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course. We're always happy to help making fun shows with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Wow, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I wonder what would be good for your next show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yesterday's show took full advantage of the plushies' cuteness.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Something in the same vein would work... But it might be fun to try something completely different, too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ooh, like what?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What about a horror show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: An exciting, spooky show starring a group of monsters who love to scare people.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ooh, that's fun! I bet it would really spook the audience to have ghosts and monsters appear in the stands!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: L-Let's not make it too scary, or we'll probably make some of the plushies cry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If we want to do something different, a mystery might be fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A mystery?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's right. Like a group of plushies solving an incident at the harbor.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Letting the audience join in on solving the mystery would be fun and exciting, wouldn't it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that does sound fun! I hope I can figure it out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Or there's also... Ah! How about a cool show?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A battle between plushies with lots of stage combat would be awesome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And it'd really shock everyone to see our cute plushies zipping all over everywhere☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we want coolness, a story starring heroes of justice would be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Imagine the plushies transforming, combining and beating up bad guys!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: C-Combining...? I can't really imagine what that would entail, but it sure sounds impressive.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's see, other cool stuff...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... At the same time, I can see clearly how much faster he is than me, and how much further down the path he is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... But, well. There's nothing for it but to do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to push forward and blaze a path for myself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, how about this kind of cool?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The main character has a big dream, but he runs into lots and lots of troubles.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But even when things are sad or painful, he pushes through step by step... And in the end, he makes it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ooh, that is cool too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That kind of steady, hard work is the coolest of all.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Steady... Ah! I just had a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: A carp plushie works super hard to swim up a river, and eventually they become a dragon! How about that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A carp turns into a dragon?! That's super cool! I like that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Steady, hard work... I feel as though we know someone who fits that bill.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. A certain someone working hard for his contest, even.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thinking about Tsukasa made me want to see a show like that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure the plushies' show will be wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, but I bet Tsukasa will be surprised to see a show that's based on him♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then let's work on it in secret, and surprise him!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! Let's all work hard with the plushies!
